detail:
Field request D13 (four graph derivation asks, wave-2 handoff) investigated by agent; controller re-verified load-bearing claims and CORRECTED the yield measurement.

CURRENT STATE: auto-populator creates file→decision decided_by edges from affected_files only (graph-auto-populator.ts:49-61); commit entities from commit_hash (:97-108). Relation schema has NO provenance marker (types.ts:156-174) but properties is free-form Record<string,string> — marker needs zero schema change; two shipped precedents to copy (rationale_source authored|derived, origin narration|discovery, both absent=legacy). Live graph here: 2293/2352 relations are decided_by — essentially everything is already machine-derived. onPost population is OFF by default (config.ts:94 auto_populate:false; decision-side deliberately unconditional, server.ts:115-117) — stock installs have a decisions-only graph, which reframes ask 2.

PREMISE CORRECTIONS (both controller-verified): (1) files_changed does not exist anywhere in the codebase — BUT inferScopeFromGit (record-tools.ts:40-65) runs git diff --name-only HEAD, holds the exact changed-file list at :48, then keeps only the common path prefix. Capturing it is ~5 lines, prospective fix. (2) "Consumer repos cannot write the graph" is likely FALSE: registerGraphTools is gated on tools.mode (default "full", server.ts:256,287,298; config.ts:90), NOT fullSurface — add_entity/add_relation are on the default 15-tool surface. Ask the field whether they run lite mode.

PER-ASK: #3 (lineage chains) is the cheapest — the exact algorithm already exists as buildSupersededChains (dashboard query-routes.ts:61-105, reads IDecisionStore only, no graph needed); lift into DecisionEngine, expose as lineage option on twining_why. #4 (declared-vs-derived marker) — zero schema change via relation properties; MUST SHIP BEFORE #1 or newly-inferred edges are indistinguishable from the 2352 unmarked legacy edges; absent=unknown semantics. #1 (derive from commit provenance) — CONTROLLER CORRECTION: agent measured the old v1 store (.twining/decisions/, 170 records; 11/13 empty-AF had no commit ref → concluded low yield). On the authoritative mirror (.twining/records/decisions/, 487): of 89 empty-affected_files decisions, 78 carry provenance.commit_sha, 80 have some commit ref — ~90% yield. Ask 1 is HIGH yield as specified, with one trap: Gate 2 runs before git commit, so provenance.commit_sha is the PARENT of the work's commit — derivation must resolve the child (ancestry walk), sound only when record→commit is 1:1. Field should run the same split on their 540. #2 (what-points-at-this) — half-served by twining_neighbors; gaps: BFS emits each entity once dropping parallel edges (graph.ts:133), no depth field, posts ungraphed by default, and onPost's related_to path is broken (passes blackboard entry IDs as relation targets, graph-auto-populator.ts:163-170, resolveEntity NOT_FOUND swallowed at :172 — 1 related_to edge in 2352 live).

ADJACENT DEFECTS FOUND: no relation dedupe in either backend (graph-store.ts:144, sqlite-stores.ts:379) — re-recording a decision duplicates decided_by edges today, and any re-runnable derivation pass needs an idempotency key; graph has no lifecycle awareness — a decided_by edge from an archived/superseded decision is indistinguishable from live, which ask 2's "live artifacts" phrasing walks straight into. Landing spot for derivation passes: alongside entity-scope-repair.ts, opt-in dry-run housekeeping (sanctioned pattern per graph.ts:32-37 comment). Converges with D11's bulk-repair recommendation: one pass can derive affected_files AND mint inferred graph edges.
summary: D13: lineage walker already exists dashboard-only; record-tools.ts:48 computes then discards changed-file list; graph write tools are default-surface; ~90% derivation yield on mirror
